VBO:0201287.summary: Active and merry, Springer Spaniels bring stamina to flushing birds from cover. The English and Welsh breeds are distinct, with a shared tradition of finding game for hunters. English Springers are typically friendly and biddable, while Welsh Springers have a kindly disposition and a reputation for companionability alongside their field work.
VBO:0201287.shortDescription: Active, merry flushing dogs, Springer Spaniels include distinct English and Welsh breeds with a long working tradition.
